overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures spray dried carrot powder for commercial and industrial formulations. Produced from carefully selected fresh carrots, our powder undergoes advanced spray-drying with controlled temperatures. This process preserves the natural orange color and characteristic aroma of the raw vegetable. The resulting fine powder offers smooth dispersibility and consistent quality, integrating smoothly into diverse food manufacturing processes.

As an FSSAI-registered supplier and IEC-registered exporter, we maintain standardized production across every batch. Our structured 6-step manufacturing process covers sourcing, sorting, drying, grinding, inspection, and dispatch. We support global food brands with export documentation, bulk supply, and custom mesh sizes. With low moisture and extended shelf life, our carrot powder delivers reliable performance for global B2B operations.
highlights: Fine particle size of 80 to 100 mesh
Natural orange color and authentic vegetable aroma
Extended shelf life of 18 to 24 months
applications: Bakery items such as breads and muffins

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for spray dried carrot powder?
faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity is 5 kg, supporting trial requirements as well as large-scale bulk procurement.

faqs.q: What is the shelf life and recommended storage condition?
faqs.a: The shelf life is 18 to 24 months when stored in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and moisture.

faqs.q: Do you provide OEM and private labeling services?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide OEM and private label services, offering packaging in custom retail pouches and jars alongside bulk options.

faqs.q: What are the primary technical specifications of this powder?
faqs.a: The powder features an 80 to 100 mesh particle size, moisture content at or below 5 percent, and spray-dried processing.

faqs.q: Are product samples available for formulation testing?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide samples upon request to assist manufacturers with recipe trials and quality evaluation.

faqs.q: Do you offer international export documentation support?
faqs.a: Yes, as an IEC-registered exporter, we supply complete export documentation support for commercial shipments worldwide.
